siteFaqFreeA: Yes. Search, reading, your library and a monthly allowance of AI credits are free. Paid plans add more credits and team features.
siteFaqCreditsA: Credits measure AI work such as summaries, chat answers and natural voices. Resora shows the cost before heavy actions and refunds credits if something fails.
siteFaqSourcesQ: Where do the papers come from?
siteFaqSourcesA: From major open scholarly databases and publishers' open-access copies. Duplicates are merged into one record.
siteFaqLanguagesA: The interface is fully translated into English and Urdu today, and results can be translated into many more languages. More interface languages are being added.
siteFaqPrivacyQ: Is my content used to train AI?
siteFaqPrivacyA: No. Resora only uses AI services and settings that do not train on your content, or models it runs itself.
siteFaqListenA: Yes. Press Listen or ask “read this paper aloud”. It skips references and page numbers, keeps playing while you browse and remembers your place.
siteFaqTeamsQ: Can my supervisor review my writing?
siteFaqTeamsA: Yes. Create a team, invite your supervisor and send a draft for review. They can approve it or ask for changes.
siteFaqCancelA: Yes. Your plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for, and your library is never deleted.
siteFaqAccuracyA: Every sentence links to the page it is based on, so you can check it. When Resora cannot find something in the paper, it says so instead of guessing.
siteFaqUploadQ: Can I upload my own PDFs?
siteFaqUploadA: Yes. Uploaded files are private to your account and are not shared with anyone unless you add them to a team project.
siteFaqStudentQ: Is there a discount for students?
siteFaqStudentA: Prices in Pakistani rupees are set for local students, and invite credits help you try paid features. Universities can ask about institution plans.
siteFaqDeleteQ: How do I delete my data?
siteFaqDeleteA: Contact us with the topic Privacy. We delete your account and content within 30 days, except invoices we must keep by law.
siteFeaturesSubtitle: What you can do with Resora today.
siteAboutLead: Resora makes research understandable for everyone, in every language.
siteAboutMission: Most research is written in English and spread across many databases. Students and researchers lose hours finding, reading and citing it. Resora brings it together, explains it honestly and speaks your language.
siteAboutPrincipleCited: Every answer shows where it came from.
siteAboutPrinciplePrivate: Your content is yours and is never used to train AI.
siteAboutPrincipleLanguage: One language setting, and the whole product speaks it.
siteAboutPrincipleHonest: When we are not sure, we say so.
siteAboutData: Resora collects paper records from open scholarly sources into its own catalog, removes duplicates, and analyses trends at scale. Licences of each source are respected.

siteHelpStillBody: Write to us and we will answer within two working days. If something is not working, check the system status first.
siteContactSubtitle: Questions, feedback or problems — we read every message.
siteContactPrivacy: We use your e-mail only to answer this message.
siteContactSent: Thank you — your message was sent. We will reply by e-mail.
siteErrorEmail: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
siteErrorConsent: Please tick the box to agree to receive e-mails.
siteErrorShort: Please write a little more so we can help.
siteErrorRate: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
siteErrorToken: This link is invalid or has already been used.
siteStatusSubtitle: Live status of Resora and recent incidents.
siteStatusUnreachable: The status service cannot be reached right now.
siteLogListenTitle: Listen to papers anywhere in Resora
siteLogListenBody: A player at the bottom keeps reading while you browse, with sections, speed, sleep timer, a listening queue and resume on any device.
siteLogAdminTitle: Help center, status page and invites
siteLogAdminBody: Find answers faster, see live system status and earn credits by inviting colleagues.
siteLogPlansBody: Choose Pro or Team with a free trial, buy credits that never expire, and work together with shared projects and reviews.
siteLogCatalogBody: Resora's own deduplicated catalog with trends, emerging topics and keyword + meaning search.
siteLogWriteBody: Draft sections and literature reviews grounded in your library, with citations in your style.
siteLogCompareBody: Methods, data, results and limitations in one table, with evidence for every cell.
stuSubtitle: Write your paper in LaTeX with images and references, compile it to PDF and switch between journal formats — alone or with your team.
stuImportNote: Turns a draft from Write into a LaTeX paper in the format chosen above.
stuNoPapers: No papers yet. Create one above.
stuConflict: A teammate saved this file after you opened it. Choose which version to keep.
stuConvertNote: Your text, figures and references stay; only the layout changes.
stuShareTitle: Work on this paper with a team
stuShareNote: Team members can edit and compile; viewers can read. Saves never overwrite a teammate's newer work.
stuNoTeams: You are not in a team yet.
stuCompileFailed: The PDF could not be built. Errors: {count}
stuPreviewLayout: The journal's own class is not installed on the server, so a close preview layout was used. The downloaded LaTeX uses the real class.
stuNoPdf: Press “Compile PDF” (Ctrl + Enter) to see your paper here.
stuUploadNote: PNG, JPG, PDF, EPS, SVG go to images/. Also .tex, .bib, .sty, .cls.
stuReadOnly: You can read and compile this paper but not edit it.
stuDeleteConfirm: Delete this paper and all its files? This cannot be undone.
stuErrCompiler: PDF compilation is not available on this server yet (LaTeX is not installed). You can still edit and download the LaTeX.
stuErrConverter: Word and web export are not available on this server yet.
stuErrBusy: Many papers are compiling right now. Try again in a moment.
stuErrPath: Use a simple file name (letters, numbers, - and _).
stuErrUnsupported: This file type is not supported.
stuErrMismatch: The file's content does not match its type.
stuErrTooLarge: The file is too large (max 10 MB).
stuErrProjectTooLarge: The paper is too large (max 40 MB in total).
stuErrSlides: Slides and papers have different layouts, so they cannot be converted into each other.
stuErrMain: The main file cannot be deleted.
stuErrConversion: The file could not be converted. Fix the LaTeX errors first.
stuErrForbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
